scripts.build: prisma generate && node scripts/build-tailwind.mjs && next build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');function cp(s,d){fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync(s,{withFileTypes:true})){const ss=path.join(s,e.name),dd=path.join(d,e.name);e.isDirectory()?cp(ss,dd):fs.copyFileSync(ss,dd)}}cp('.next/static','.next/standalone/.next/static');cp('public','.next/standalone/public');console.log('Static assets copied to standalone.')"
